condition.name: names_only
condition.description: names replaced by one placeholder, gendered pronouns kept: the two documents of a pair differ only in he/his/him versus she/her

definition: contrast = tie-aware % male-favored on male-typed occupations minus the same on female-typed occupations (ties count half); points

design.request_layout: one request per query: its 8 documents, male version first within each pair, templates in the audit's order (professional_bio, resume_summary, news_article, linkedin_style)

bootstrap.resampling: occupations with replacement within category (interval_sensitivity.py `occupation` scheme, contrast_draws with resample_names=False)
bootstrap.seed: stable_seed(<audited model id>, 'occupation', 'contrast'), the seed interval_sensitivity.py uses, so the pronouns-only and original draws resample the same occupations and change_vs_original is a paired interval
bootstrap.interval: 95%, individual (not adjusted for the number of models)

jinaai/jina-reranker-v3.reason: listwise reranker: it scores all of a request's documents jointly, so its scores depend on the request's composition, and requests of 8 placeholder documents are not comparable with its audit requests of 80 documents; its original contrast is about zero (see original_contrast / original_ci)
